title: Map of brain ‘microproteins’ could offer new clues to Alzheimer’s disease
title_zh: 大脑“微蛋白”地图或为阿尔茨海默病提供新线索
abstract: Researchers detect more than 1,000 overlooked microproteins in human brain tissue, including some that are altered in Alzheimer’s disease.
abstract_zh: 研究人员在人体脑组织中检测到超过1,000种被忽视的微蛋白，其中一些在阿尔茨海默病中发生改变。
snippet: Researchers detect more than 1,000 overlooked microproteins in human brain tissue, including some that are altered in Alzheimer’s disease.
